description: AI generation benchmark intent set. Tiers follow BioAgents L1-L3 complexity levels; success = all three static gates pass (validate/dry-run/lint, deterministic).

intents.intent: Quality control of paired-end FASTQ reads with fastp, and aggregate reports with MultiQC
Run FastQC quality check on raw sequencing reads for a cohort of samples
Adapter and quality trimming of small RNA sequencing reads with cutadapt
RNA-seq analysis pipeline: fastp QC and trimming, STAR alignment to a reference genome, featureCounts gene quantification, and MultiQC summary
Germline SNV calling: fastp preprocessing, bwa-mem alignment, samtools sorting and indexing, bcftools variant calling and filtering
ChIP-seq peak calling pipeline: fastp QC, bowtie2 alignment against a reference genome, samtools processing, MACS2 peak calling
ATAC-seq analysis: fastp QC, bwa-mem2 alignment, properly paired read filtering, MACS2 peak calling with shift model, and fragment-size QC
Metagenomic profiling of shotgun reads: fastp QC, kraken2 taxonomic classification, bracken abundance re-estimation, and a Krona visualization chart
Tumor-normal somatic variant calling: fastp QC, bwa-mem alignment of both samples, samtools processing, Strelka2 somatic SNV and indel calling
